scope.items_are: outward-facing changes only — project-internal maintenance (repo upkeep, convention changes, documentation updates) never becomes an item (REDESIGN.md L3). This is a scoping rule about what counts as an item, enforced in the schema and the agent guidelines; it is NOT a trimming rule and there is no filter for it in the validator.
scope.intel_brewfile: out of this tool entirely (REDESIGN.md B1); I-17 checks it
scope.deterministic_layer: validates, normalizes, counts, buckets, calculates impact. Never deletes, trims or re-rates.

memory_proposals.bucket_rule: memory proposals do not force `attention`; action proposals do. `watch-item` and `method-note` propose changes to what we remember, `edit` and `structural` to the user's system — only the latter needs a decision. Every axis that can pre-accept (compute_impact, compute_risk_level, compute_initial_bucket, W-ATTENTION-NOSUG) asks `needs_a_decision`, a NEGATION, so a kind outside the vocabulary demands a decision rather than reading as a memory proposal.

method-note.method_topic: what the note is about, in a few words
method-note.method_note: the instruction itself, written to read sensibly when copied verbatim into the next run's context
method-note.rationale: the failure the ordinary research path already produced here

watch-item.watch_topic: the short phrase a future run matches against its changelog
watch-item.watch_note: the context that lets a future hit explain itself without re-deriving everything
watch-item.rationale: your answers to the self-test, in your own words

self_test_failed.rule: REDESIGN.md L7 — the self-test TAGS, never removes. A failing proposal is still written; convergence reviews every tagged one and verifies that dropping it is appropriate. A proposal the agent never writes is one convergence cannot restore.
self_test_failed.on_a_non_memory_kind: E-FIELD-TYPE — the tag is present iff the kind is a memory kind

fields.name: body
fields.note: the detail: why/how. Overflow from title lands here

fields.name: local.evidence
fields.required: yes if local present, may be []

fields.name: watch_hit
fields.note: set iff this item answers a stored watch item for this tool

fields.name: watch_hit.topic
fields.note: VERBATIM copy of the stored watch item's `topic`

item_sort_key: negated severity rank (worst first; unknown severity last)
direction rank (reaches, unclear, does_not_reach, no local block)
effect rank (risk, none, benefit, no local block)
id ascending — the tiebreak that makes the order total

flags.on_disagreement: the validator's value wins; E-FLAG-DISAGREE is raised

security_display.predicate: rating == critical, or exploited_in_wild, or local.direction == reaches, or severity in (warning, incompatible)

E-ANCHOR-MALFORMED.summary: `anchor.value` does not match its kind's grammar

E-CITE-KIND.summary: a citation kind is outside the vocabulary

E-CITE-URL.summary: a citation url is not an absolute http(s) URL

E-ENTRY-NOID.summary: a research entry has no usable string id

E-ENTRY-NOTOBJECT.summary: a research entry is not an object

E-ENUM-INVALID.summary: a field's value is outside its closed vocabulary

E-EVID-MALFORMED.summary: an evidence entry is not a path

E-FIELD-TYPE.summary: a field has the wrong type

E-FLAG-DISAGREE.summary: a checker-emitted flag disagrees with recomputation

E-FLAG-FORBIDDEN.summary: a checker emitted a validator-only flag

E-INTEL-BREWFILE.summary: intel.Brewfile is out of this tool entirely

E-ITEM-DUP-ANCHOR.summary: two items in one tool derive one id

E-RESEARCH-NOTARRAY.summary: a research file is not a JSON array

E-RESEARCH-UNKNOWNKEY.summary: a research object carries a top-level key outside the closed set (kept in quarantine)

E-RESEARCH-UNREADABLE.summary: a research file could not be read

E-SEC-BLOCK-ORPHAN.summary: `security` block on an item not tagged `security`

E-STRUCT-PRECOND.summary: a structural op's precondition does not hold

E-TAG-NONE.summary: no recognized tag on the item

E-TAG-UNKNOWN.summary: a tag outside the closed set (kept verbatim)

E-VALIDATOR-CRASH.summary: a validator stage failed on this tool; it is kept with what conformed

E-WATCH-HIT-NOLOCAL.summary: a watch-item hit with no `local` block

E-WATCH-HIT-UNGROUNDED.summary: `watch_hit.topic` names no stored watch item for this tool

W-ENTRY-DUPLICATE.summary: two research entries claim one tool id

W-ENTRY-UNMATCHED.summary: a research entry names no collected candidate

W-EVID-ROOT.summary: an evidence path resolves only under an unconfigured repo

W-MEMBER-QUARANTINED.summary: a wrong-typed array member was quarantined, not dropped

W-SHAPE-COERCED.summary: a field was the wrong shape and was coerced

W-STRUCT-UNCHECKED.summary: a structural precondition could not be checked

W-SUG-DUP-ID.summary: a suggestion id is not unique across the report

W-TITLE-LONG.summary: title is longer than the glanceable bar; detail belongs in body

W-WATCH-HIT-UNRAISED.summary: a watch-item hit left at `info`; a watched topic earns at least `notable`

W-WATCH-UNCHECKED.summary: a watch-item hit could not be checked against the stored watch items

anchor_grammars.none: value must be null; a non-empty `slug` is required instead
